checks.detail: Each spawned process loads frozen model, OT uncertainty and mask provider in its own worker context. There is no shared mutable SAM image cache across processes; each process executes one frame call at a time.
Master binds each future to its submitted frame ID, rejects changed or duplicate returned IDs, and reconstructs results in the complete original _frames order.

_frames requires primary CAL46/TEST49 nonsevere95 and appends the3 preregistered real RGB crops. A failed future prevents prediction sealing; partial successful rows cannot become a scored population.

Worker/initializer/predict never invoke score or open annotation targets. Frames carry explicit prediction fields only. Current RGB, q, K, native dimensions/coarse pose and frozen CAL-trained models enter runtime; source label transforms remain in separate postseal score.

Protocol records primary input hash, frozen model descriptor/checkpoint bindings, crop file/input/preregistration bindings and complete ordered IDs. Source binding includes both new parallel runner and Jacobian module, and source snapshots are copied with digest verification. Master rechecks source/crop bindings before writing one complete predictions file/seal.

56 P3P triple cap,24 global rotations,160 seed nfev,250 joint iterations,256 T union cap,3 Mahalanobis budget and every O/T constraint are preserved. Exact derivative flag changes numerical derivatives, not pose freedom, domain definitions, observations, objective or hard constraints.

Jacobian module uses the same rotation-vector/translation-scale projection, radial pseudo-Huber values, positive-depth constraints, per-BI seed/absolute guards and every ellipse/box/halfplane/T inequality in the same order. Clipped denominator derivatives match the finite extension away from its nondifferentiable boundaries.

assumptions: Frozen v3 descriptor, parameter arrays, checkpoints and original prediction input stay immutable throughout this run, as instructed. Workers revalidate immutable checkpoint/array bindings when loading.
limitations: Independent-frame execution shares the physical GPU, but models, masks and pose optimization state are process-local.
The same mathematical problem can converge differently with more accurate derivatives; preserve the separate evaluation_v2 protocol rather than relabeling the aborted numeric attempt.
